title: RelayShield Security Tools (MCP) output
description: This Actor runs in Standby mode as a live MCP server. It does not write to a dataset -- its output is the running Streamable HTTP endpoint itself, which MCP clients connect to directly.

mcpServerUrl.title: MCP server endpoint
mcpServerUrl.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for this Actor run. Add it to an MCP client's server config, with an Apify API token as a bearer token.
